items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: with Chauncey Morehouse, Charlie Spivak, Jimmy Lytell, Claude Thornhill, who made them on the Varsity record.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. with Chauncey Morehouse, Charlie Spivak, Jimmy Lytell, Claude Thornhill, who made them on the Varsity record. That's when Spivak says, you know about the blues, teach me how to play a chord. He played a nice chorus of blues on there. I didn't show him nothing. I said, man, just play natural. Nobody can show you that stuff, it has to come to you. Played a nice chorus on it.
Does your lip ever get tired when you play? Do you, some people say the more they play, the better it gets.

items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: Then we come down to your band, Chauncey Morehouse and his Swing Six. Charlie Spivak on trumpet, George Brunies -trombone

ctx.x: Yeah. And then he would go into that.

Then we come down to your band, Chauncey Morehouse and his Swing Six. Charlie Spivak on trumpet, George Brunies -trombone, quite a setup, Jimmy Lytell on clarinet, Claude Thornhill on piano, Artie Bernstein on string bass and you on the drums and vibes.
